notes.title: Update: Balance Adjustments & New Features
notes.notes:
Balance Adjustments
Balance tweaks for ghost units

Probability adjustments to reduce reliance on luck (details are secret)
New Features
Added an option to turn off customer crying sounds

Added a config icon on the start screen
Notes
Previously, I mentioned that a larger update was planned.
However, since it was taking longer than expected, I released some smaller updates first.

This update reflects player reviews and feedback to a reasonable extent.
(Please note that not every piece of feedback has been implemented.)

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: It has been one week since the release.
notes.notes:
It has been a little over a week since the release.

I would like to sincerely thank everyone who has played the game.

I’ve also been enjoying reading the reviews you’ve shared.
Thankfully, no critical bugs or major issues have been reported so far. I plan to wait a bit longer before rolling out a consolidated update.

Based on the feedback from all of you, as well as my own reflections, I will continue creating works that further enhance the charm of the world and its characters.

Thank you for your continued support.

Kyuko

notes.title: Release Date Confirmed!
notes.notes:
Thank you so much for your patience!
We’re excited to announce that HauntedManager finally has a release date!

Coming August 6th!
We’ve also given the store page a major update—be sure to check it out!
